y-m-18-03.title: Xalka garaafka kooxda Haeun: maxaa yaab ah?
y-m-18-03.topic: Muujinta xogta garaaf kooxeed iyo hubinteeda
y-m-18-03.goal: Xal xisaabinta boqolkiiba, hel safka khaldan iyo tilmaanta ah ‘haddii wadartu aysan ahayn 100%, waa khalad,’ oo samee tirooyin sahan siinaya isla garaaf kooxeed.
y-m-18-03.material: Haeun, arday fasalka 6aad ah, wuxuu ka dhigay 40-ka arday ee fasalkiisa mid kasta inuu doorto ‘xilliga uu ugu jecel yahay.’ Natiijooyinka waa guga 12 arday, xagaaga 14 arday, dayrta 8 arday, iyo jiilaalka 6 arday. Haeun wuxuu u xalliyey sida hoose si uu ugu muujiyo garaaf kooxeed. Dhammaan kooxda garaafka kooxeedku waa 100%.
y-m-18-03.thinking.1: Hubinta naftaada adigoo isticmaalaya shuruudda ah wadarta waa 100%
y-m-18-03.thinking.2: Xaqiijinta in dhowr cabbir sahan ay samayn karaan isla garaaf kooxeed
y-m-18-03.prereq.0: Xiriirka u dhexeeya tobanaadyada iyo boqolkiibaha (%)
y-m-18-03.prereq.1: Macnaha ah koox dhan oo garaaf kooxeed waa 100%
y-m-18-03.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal safka khaldan ee xalka Haeun. (Tirooyinka safafka waxaa laga tiriyaa 1.)
y-m-18-03.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi saf kasta adigoo boqolkiibka dib ugu beddelaya tirada dadka (tusaale: imisa ka mid ah 40 arday ayay 30% tahay).
y-m-18-03.s.s1.hint.1: Eeg haddii natiijada safka ugu dambeeya ay ku habboon tahay shuruudda garaaf kooxeed.
y-m-18-03.s.s1.line.5: Isku darista dhammaan boqollaalayaasha waxay siinaysaa 30+35+2+15=82%. Weli, waxaad buuxin kartaa oo sawiri kartaa xariiqda ilaa 82% oo keliya.
y-m-18-03.s.s1.explain: Safka 4, 0.2 waa 20%, laakiin waxaa loo qoray 2%. Safka 6 na, calaamadda ah wadartu waa 82% ma aha 100% ayaa la arkay laakiin garaafka ayaa lagu sawiray. Wadarta xariiqda garaafka waa 100%, sidaas darteed haddii boqollaalayaasha aysan isku darmin 100, saf qaar ayaa khaldan.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.prompt: Garaafka xariiqda ee sahan fasal kale wuxuu leeyahay ‘dodgeball 40%, kubbadda cagta 30%, xadhig-boodis 20%, kuwa kale 10%.’ Samee 2 nuqul oo kala duwan oo tirada dadka la sahamiyay N (arday) iyo tirada shay kasta oo siin kara garaafkan xariiqda. (N waa tiro dabiici ah oo 60 ama ka yar.)
y-m-18-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kuwa kale waa 10%, sidaas darteed marka hore qor imisa arday ayaa shay kasta ah haddii wadarta ay tahay 10 arday.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.hint.1: Beddelidda wadarta tirada dadka, hubi haddii shay kasta uu u soo baxo tiro dabiici ah oo arday ah.
y-m-18-03.s.s2.hint.2: Hubi haddii tirooyinka dadka aad samaysay ay waafaqsan yihiin wadarta tirada ardayda iyo haddii boqollaalayaashu aysan is beddelin.

y-m-18-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Wadarta tirooyinka dadka ee shayada way ka duwan tahay wadarta tirada ardayda.

y-m-18-05.title: Haddii aan labada fasal isku darno, waa maxay celceliska guud?

y-m-18-05.material: Fasalka 1 iyo Fasalka 2 ee fasalka 6aad waxay qaadeen isla qiimeyn xisaabeed. Dhammaan buundooyinku waa 0 ilaa 100 dhibcood. y-m-18-05.thinking.2: Samaynta isku-darka tirooyinka dadka ee ku habboon shuruudaha

y-m-18-05.s.s1.r.a: Celceliska guud wuxuu sii ku dhowaadaa celceliska dhinaca leh arday badan. Markaas ka fikir haddii ay noqon laheyd 75 dhibcood.

y-m-18-05.s.s1.r.b: Tani waxay tixgelisay in cabbirka kooxdu uu saameeyo celceliska. Haddii cabbirradu siman yihiin, labada celcelis si siman ayay u tirsan yihiin.

y-m-18-05.s.s1.explain: Marka labada fasal ay leeyihiin tiro arday oo isku mid ah oo keliya ayuu celceliska guud yahay 75 dhibcood, bartamaha saxda ah ee labada celcelis. Haddii tirooyinka ardayda ay kala duwan yihiin, celceliska guud wuxuu u dhaqaaqaa fasalka leh arday badan.
y-m-18-05.s.s2.prompt: Hadda waad ogtahay in Fasalka 1 uu leeyahay 20 arday Fasalka 2 na uu leeyahay 30 arday. Sidee celceliska guud ula barbar dhigaa 75 dhibcood?
y-m-18-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir fasalka 20-ka arday ama fasalka 30-ka arday kee ayaa buundooyinkiisu saameyn badan ku leh wadarta.

y-m-18-05.s.s2.r.a: Waxaad isku qasatay celcelisyada labada fasal oo leh tirooyin arday oo kala duwan sida inta siman.

y-m-18-05.s.s2.r.c: Waad taqaan labada fasal tirooyinka ardayda iyo celcelisyada, sidaas darteed waad go'aamin kartaa jihada.

y-m-18-02.title: Marka aad tuurto laba lacag-qori, natiijadee ayaa ugu badan soo baxda?
y-m-18-02.topic: Fursad: ka shaqaynta adigoo u kala qaybinaya kiisas
y-m-18-02.goal: Barbar dhig laba sharaxaad (saddexda natiijo dhammaantood waa isku mid / eeg lacag-qoryaha si gooni gooni ah oo u kala qaybi kiisas) xogta tijaabada, hagaaji xukunkaaga, oo sheeg sababta aan u kala qaybinno kiisas.

 Jia: “Waxaa jira saddex natiijo: [labadaba madax], [hal madax iyo hal dabo], iyo [labadaba dabo], sidaas darteed dhammaantood waxay leeyihiin isla fursad.” 
 Minho: “Waxaa jira laba lacag-qori, sidaas darteed waa inaan si gooni gooni ah u eegnaa sida lacag-qori kastaa u soo baxdo.”

y-m-18-04.topic: Cabbirka iyo barbar dhigidda garaaf baar ah
y-m-18-04.goal: Ogow in garaaf baar ah oo cabbirkiisa uusan ka bilaabmin 0, saamiga dhererka baararka iyo saamiga qiimayaasha ay kala duwanaan karaan, oo soo jeedi hababka looga hortago fahan-xumada.
y-m-18-04.material: Tirada buugaagta la iibiyay bishan dukaamada buugaagta ee xaafadda A iyo B waxaa lagu muujiyay garaaf baar ah. y-m-18-07.s.s2.r.d: Waxaad ku adkaysatay inay si sax ah isku mid tahay, adigoo ku salaynaya tirada dadka. Haddii dad kale la soo xulo, natiijadu sidoo kale waxay noqon kartaa wax yar kala duwan.
